name: B10-0215/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a standing committee on Security and Defence and a standing committee on Public Health
part_text:
The European Parliament is creating two new permanent committees. One covers security and defence, taking over the work of an existing subcommittee and gaining a say over European defence policy, defence industry and military cooperation. The other covers public health, taking over from a public health subcommittee and handling medicines, medical devices, health crises and mental health. The committee on the environment loses public health from its name and keeps environment, climate and food safety.

- Two new committees replace two subcommittees, each with 43 members.
- Security and defence work moves from a subcommittee to a full committee.
- The change starts on the first day of the next part-session.
